images.prompt: Natural product photograph of one pair of plain over-ear headphones folded neatly on a small matte gray circular table. Two oval earcups sit near the center and one curved headband arcs behind them. No cable. Soft window light from upper right, neutral studio room background, elevated three-quarter camera. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Full objects visible with breathing room. Natural photography, realistic materials and lighting; no text, logo, watermark, or illustration.

review.reason: Independently inspected: one complete unbranded headphone set has two distinct earcups, a connected arched headband and visible hinges/gaps on a gray table. Natural window illumination, room context and material detail are coherent; no lettering or watermark.

images.actual_source_analysis: One black over-ear headphone set lies folded on a round matte gray tabletop. Two separate oval earcups occupy the front center, the left cup lower and farther left than the right; both have thick padded rims and plain outer shells. A single broad curved headband arcs behind the cups and connects through short jointed arms at the outer left and right. All headphone parts and the gap inside the band are visible, with no cable. Daylight enters from the upper right window. A pale curtain fills the center background, a leafy potted plant and dark shelf appear at upper left, and the table legs extend below.

images.prompt:
Fine-grained nephrite-like jade with gentle subsurface scattering, cloudy mineral variation, and restrained polish.
Preserve: Subject count, outer silhouette, openings, attachments, and contact points. Source camera viewpoint, framing, relative scale, and placement. Recognizable subject identity and existing background structure.
Translate existing solid subject surfaces into fine-grained jade with gentle subsurface scattering, retaining all holes, gaps, and attached parts.
Use pale sage, milky ivory, and muted green-gray veins sampled as subtle mineral variation rather than decorative patterns.
Define contours through smooth rounded edges and changing thickness; do not carve new relief patterns.
Introduce restrained cloudy inclusions and fine mineral grain within solid areas, never large contrasting marble veins.
Keep source lighting; thin edges transmit softly while thick volumes remain denser and less translucent.
Preserve subject count, camera angle, framing, placement, and negative spaces between components.
Retain small functional joints and surface transitions as recognizable shapes without inventing carved ornaments.
Use a low-gloss waxy polish with softened highlights and grounded shadows, avoiding plastic opacity or emerald brilliance.
Change existing solid surfaces and their material response only; retain parts, silhouettes, openings, and placement.
Use the supplied photograph as the sole composition reference. Keep the entire source frame, original 4:5 aspect ratio, camera viewpoint, subject scale, and all margins. Produce at least 1024x1280 pixels. Output only the finished image.
Avoid: Carved dragons, floral relief, symbols, tassels, or decorative pedestals. Closed gaps, fused parts, duplicated components, or changed proportions. Neon green glass, plastic shine, text, logos, or watermarks.

review.reason: Independent comparison confirms the two earcups, hinges, padded rims, headband arc and open interior gap retain their source structure and placement. Pale jade has restrained mineral clouding, waxy sheen and brighter thin edges while thick regions remain denser. No added carvings, bases, fused joints or logos.
